## Metrics Overview

Governance metrics provide quantitative measurement of governance effectiveness, enabling:

- Data-driven assessment of governance performance
- Objective measurement of compliance and quality outcomes
- Continuous improvement through performance tracking
- Stakeholder reporting and transparency
- Benchmarking against industry standards and best practices
